selection_rule.unit: one public task with two independent fresh arms
selection_rule.universe: all supplied public task metadata; no reference patch/hints inspected
selection_rule.exclude: any task ID present in parent-tracked textual files before this study; conservative metadata mentions count as exposed
selection_rule.ordering: ascending SHA256 of UTF8(s1-egv-v01-fresh-01: + instance_id), lexical ID tiebreak
selection_rule.replacement: none in same proposed study; stop if selected snapshot fails later baseline admission
selection_rule.order_rule: EGV first if lowest bit of SHA256(s1-egv-order-v01: + selected ID) is 1; otherwise Control first
selection_rule.timing: select only after CPU acceptance, before future task outcome/Issue inspection

control.readiness: CPU gate required; E2-E4 GPU not registered

egv.architecture: Prompt-only EGV; no external decision controller
egv.added_rule: Before running a behavioral check, use existing evidence to decide whether it can test your current repair hypothesis: does the input reach the relevant behavior, does it execute the current workspace implementation, and what new result could change your patch or plan? If any link is unsupported, fix the smallest gap first. Inspect or assert the expected outcome; exit zero alone is insufficient. Repeat a check when code, inputs, environment, hypothesis, or a justified confidence requirement changes; otherwise investigate its existing evidence rather than rerunning unchanged. Retain relevant old-behavior regressions. When sufficient checks are complete, review and submit the patch, stating unverified risks.

snapshot.status: sealed official download;archive headers/CRC checked;source and reference repair not inspected

fresh_baseline_status: not_run; must be sealed/admitted before separate authorization and execution
primary_endpoint: Unmodified complete official resolved,with native test_exit_code and original Phase2/JUnit
mechanism_endpoints: actual target execution with graded evidence
unchanged non-discriminating tests; legitimate repeats counted separately
LLM/tool/time and observed complete-or-partial Token usage
interpretation: One paired task is mechanism smoke,not population resolution rate;fewer checks with worse correctness is negative
stop: Unknown/error infrastructure,hash/request drift,leakage,missing/conflicting JUnit,unexplained cancellation,unproven cleanup/idle or resources;ordinary assertion failure continues other arm
blocking_requirements: verify sealed snapshot/task-record/evaluator-test hashes on future official input mount
clean native full baseline with path/JUnit/cleanup evidence;on failure stop selected task without replacement
freeze final executable Notebook and identical worker/observer config for both arms
publish final registration before any launch and obtain separate GPU authorization
runtime_dependency_admission: Record effective imports/versions from fresh baseline,not wheel filenames alone;match both arms
